cases.name: linear-handles
cases.contract: Endpoint detaches imported anchor; Undo restores. Separation and text drags retain anchor. Aligned/h/v separation branches; text reset actual button; zero-displacement no history.

cases.name: angular-radius
cases.contract: Actual arc midpoint handle; outward drag and min2mm clamp; release one command, Undo/Redo.

cases.name: radial-endpoint
cases.contract: Actual arc endpoint handle; radius/angle mutation and min1mm clamp; literal source callback exception retained separately from geometry.

cases.name: label-leaders
cases.contract: Primary and extra tips detach only their own anchors; Ctrl-tip copies new leader; extra dropped inside ink removes it; Undo/Redo each gesture.

cases.name: label-wrap-width
cases.contract: Selected wrap corner actual hit outside ink; width minimum4mm, derived text height observed; Undo/Redo.

cases.name: callout-bubble-and-box
cases.contract: Bubble tip moves bx/by only; ordinary lower-right box resize w/h; Undo/Redo and source generic snapping.

cases.name: locked-hidden-handle-admission
cases.contract: Overlapped z/hidden/locked source canvas hit admission; no programmatic locked mutation claim; no-op press/release and Escape during captured drag recorded literally.

cases.name: chain-fresh-jog
cases.contract: Fresh first2points+offset then collinear/jog segment; repeated-last terminates and totals; local Undo/Redo including total; armed state remains.

cases.name: chain-anchored-undo
cases.contract: Same-frame real snap points; segments acquire anchors; Undo midrun/rebuild continuation; Escape ends and total; secondEscape Select.

cases.name: chain-seeded-and-switch
cases.contract: Actual selected unlocked existing cota seeds run; Shift horizontal/vertical lock; tool switch ends total; new run then sheet switch retirement.

cases.name: baseline-fresh-and-seeded
cases.contract: Fresh and selected seed runs; positive/negative separation and document base_step_mm; no total; short run Escape and tool switch.

cases.name: multi-ctrl-properties
cases.contract: Actual Ctrl-click text toggles with onepixel wobble; samekind changed-field property propagation/coalescence; differing untouched fields preserved; mixedkind unaffected.

cases.name: multi-box-admission
cases.contract: Actual empty-page LTRwindow/RTLcrossing; Ctrladd/Shifttoggle/bothremove; hidden/locked/stacking bounds; blankclick clears; selection immutable/nohistory.

cases.name: multi-group-move-delete
cases.contract: Actual selected mixed annotation group bodydrag; one compound localUndo; no handles masquerading as body; Deleteall/Undo/Redo exact source order+selection.

observations: sorted selection family/index identities (not Qt enumeration order)
pending primary/angular/radial/run points, sep, axis and live cota membership
actual quantized page pointer positions and top item/handle admission
declared opaque raw leaves before/after native save

rules.ingress: Real QtTest viewport pointer/key and enabled toolbar/property controls. Fixture publication/selection/rebuild explicitly separate. Quantized hit must be shape/bounds-contained and resolve intended specialized handle or body before gestures.
rules.operative: Each changed release must prove intended fields changed and exact local history increment; no-op observations remain exact. Never simulate a specialized handle with body drag.
rules.errors: All source exceptions retained literally. Known radial property population AttributeError may occur; allowlist must be exact function/phase, no manufactured source success.
rules.history: Observe actual source Undo/Redo and selection, including any defects. Escape during mouse capture is literal source behavior, not assumed rollback.
rules.scope: Single-owner handle gestures plus explicitly declared multi-selection groups. No combinatorial all-kind/permutation matrix or physical pixel recapture.
rules.capture: One coherent capture only after geometry and validation full producer prereview. Existing accepted source corpora unchanged.
